title: The merged build is checked on hs1 and on Apple silicon
body:
Refactor reached dev as the squash commit f085e43, so the checks that waited on the merge now run against dev. The note below holds the benchmark and hash results of refactor 453e2d0 against dev 657e16d on catalyst. Jeb squash-merged, so the per-commit build check no longer applies.

Still to run:

- On catalyst, build hs1 with 657e16d and with f085e43, unmasked, with `-d`, and under a seed mask, and compare the `.sufr` hashes. A difference is either explained by a commit or is a bug.
- On an Apple silicon machine, check `lcp_neon` in `libsufr/src/lcp.rs`: the suite, `lcp` against `lcp_scalar` over every mismatch position and the cache probe points, and byte-identical output against an x86 build of the same commit.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/b57eb726
notes.text:
Jeb plans to squash-merge refactor, so the per-commit build-and-test check is dropped.

At refactor 453e2d0 against dev 657e16d on catalyst: `cargo fmt --check` is clean, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` gives 4 warnings, and `cargo test --workspace --release` passes.

suffix-bench `measure` with `-n 2000`, no cap and no `--dna`, through the wrapper `vendor/sufr/sufr-refactor-453e2d0` (it moves `-t` after the subcommand and drops `-m 0`). Medians of wall time and peak RSS:

| input | threads | runs | dev | refactor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| easy | 4 | 5 | 10.7 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| withn | 4 | 5 | 10.7 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| sim1clone | 4 | 5 | 1.0 s, 66 MB | 0.8 s, 49 MB |
| amino | 4 | 5 | 10.4 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| chr1 | 4 | 5 | 30.2 s, 782 MB | 31.5 s, 934 MB |
| uniprot_sprot | 4 | 5 | 19.7 s, 474 MB | 8.1 s, 520 MB |
| hg38 | 32 | 3 | 131.5 s, 9638 MB | 93.2 s, 12021 MB |

Every `.sufr` matched dev byte for byte: the seven above, and at 32 threads hg38 `-d`, hg38 `-d -s 1110111`, chr1 `-d -i`, and uniprot_sprot with `--write-lcp`, `-s 11011` and `-s 11011 --write-lcp`.

Not run yet: hs1, and the NEON check on Apple silicon.
